sentences.en: Hello and welcome to Speaking of Psychology, a podcast produced by the American Psychological
sentences.zh: 您好，欢迎收看《心理学谈话》，这是一档由美国心理学

sentences.en: Association.
sentences.zh: 学会制作的播客。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人奥德丽·汉密尔顿。

sentences.en: In this episode, I talk with a psychologist about the obesity epidemic and why families can struggle to maintain healthy eating habits, especially older children and teens.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我和一位心理学家探讨了肥胖流行病，以及为什么家庭在维持健康饮食习惯时会遇到困难，特别是针对大龄儿童和青少年。

sentences.en: So even if parents are doing a really good job of being role models at home, kids still have a really hard time and their role models of their peers, which
sentences.zh: 因此，即使父母在家里作为榜样做得非常好，孩子们仍然会觉得很难，而同龄人的榜样作用

sentences.en: are important during adolescence are often driving them to pretty unhealthful habits.
sentences.zh: 在青春期尤为重要，往往会促使他们养成相当不健康的习惯。

sentences.en: It's not just about telling your kids to choose fruits over chips.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是告诉你的孩子选择水果而不是薯片那么简单。

sentences.en: Psychological research has a lot to offer in terms of how teens and their parents can be more mindful eaters, encouraging them to adopt healthier, lifelong habits.
sentences.zh: 心理学研究在帮助青少年及其父母如何更有觉知地进食、鼓励他们养成更健康的终身习惯方面，有很多宝贵的建议。

sentences.en: Eleanor Mackey is a child psychologist with Children's National Medical
sentences.zh: 埃莉诺·麦基是华盛顿特区

sentences.en: Center in the Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 地区国家儿童医疗中心的

sentences.en: area.
sentences.zh: 儿童心理学家。

sentences.en: She is also a member of the Children's Obesity Institute, an interdisciplinary team of physicians, researchers, and mental health professionals
sentences.zh: 她也是儿童肥胖研究所的成员，这是一个由儿科医生、研究人员和心理健康专家组成的跨学科团队，

sentences.en: committed to preventing childhood obesity.
sentences.zh: 致力于预防儿童肥胖。

sentences.en: She counsels children and teens who struggle with eating and weight problems and continues to conduct research on obesity treatment.
sentences.zh: 她为那些与饮食和体重问题作斗争的儿童和青少年提供咨询，并继续开展肥胖治疗的研究。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Mackey.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，麦基博士。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We see a lot of focus on encouraging healthy eating habits in young children, which is understandable.
sentences.zh: 我们看到很多关注点都放在鼓励幼儿养成健康饮食习惯上，这是可以理解的。

sentences.en: We have young children.
sentences.zh: 我们有幼儿。

sentences.en: Young children are going to be fussier eaters.
sentences.zh: 幼儿往往是更挑食的食客。

sentences.en: Parents want to make sure they're helping them develop healthy eating habits early in life.
sentences.zh: 父母希望确保他们能在人生早期帮助孩子养成健康的饮食习惯。

sentences.en: But what about teens?
sentences.zh: 但青少年呢？

sentences.en: You know, what are some of the issues that bring older children into the clinic where you work and how do you help them?
sentences.zh: 你知道，是什么样的问题把大龄儿童带到你工作的诊所？你又是如何帮助他们的？

sentences.en: Well, I think you might be surprised that there are certainly picky eaters, many of them still as teenagers, and I think that presents their own unique challenges.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想你可能会惊讶，确实还有挑食者，他们中的许多人在十几岁时依然如此，我认为这带来了他们自己独特的挑战。

sentences.en: And oftentimes we have kids come in who are just not eating enough variety of healthful foods or not engaging in exercise.
sentences.zh: 通常我们遇到一些孩子，他们只是没有吃足够多样化的健康食品，或者不参与锻炼。

sentences.en: And they've come to the attention of physicians because they've started developing difficulties and other medical conditions related to that.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以引起医生的注意，是因为他们开始出现困难以及与之相关的其他健康状况。

sentences.en: And so concerns about their health really drive them to our clinics.
sentences.zh: 因此，对他们健康的担忧真正推动他们来到了我们的诊所。

sentences.en: I guess I'm admittedly encouraging healthier eating behaviors in older children is an uphill battle.
sentences.zh: 我想我不得不承认，鼓励大龄儿童采取更健康的饮食行为是一场硬仗。

sentences.en: You know, they're more independent.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们更加独立了。

sentences.en: You know, you may not have sugary sodas in your refrigerator at home, but chances are their friends will or maybe at school, you know, who knows?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你家里冰箱里可能没有含糖汽水，但他们的朋友家里很可能会有，或者也许在学校里，谁知道呢？

sentences.en: You know, we live in a culture where fast food is everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们生活在一个快餐无处不在的文化中。

sentences.en: Do you see the trend toward more healthy foods trickling down to teens or, you know, how can parents encourage that at home?
sentences.zh: 你是否看到更多健康食品的趋势正逐渐渗透到青少年中？或者，你知道，父母如何在家里鼓励这种趋势？

sentences.en: I think you're right that that's such a challenge and I think kids are still surrounded by an unhealthy eating culture.
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的，这确实是一个巨大的挑战，而且我认为孩子们仍然被不健康的饮食文化所包围。

sentences.en: And a lot of kids come back to our clinics and tell us that a lot of their social events revolve around food.
sentences.zh: 很多孩子回到我们的诊所告诉我们，他们的许多社交活动都围绕着食物展开。

sentences.en: They go out to eat with their friends or different activities that they're at include unhealthful foods.
sentences.zh: 他们和朋友一起出去吃饭，或者他们参加的不同活动都包含不健康的食物。

sentences.en: So even if parents are doing a really good job of being role models at home and making sure that the food environment at home is full of plenty of
sentences.zh: 因此，即使父母在家里作为榜样做得非常好，并确保家里的食物环境充满了充足的

sentences.en: easily available and good tasting healthy foods, kids still have a really hard time and their role
sentences.zh: 容易获得且美味的健康食品，孩子们仍然会遇到很大的困难，而他们同龄人的

sentences.en: models of their peers, which are important during adolescence, are often driving them to pretty unhealthful habits.
sentences.zh: 榜样作用——这在青春期非常重要——往往会促使他们养成相当不健康的习惯。

sentences.en: So what sort of methods or what sort of techniques do you use with these teens who are struggling in those environments?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于这些在那种环境中苦苦挣扎的青少年，你使用什么样的方法或技术？

sentences.en: I think it's important to make sure that you sort of tackle it on two different fronts.
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的是要确保你从两个不同的方面来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: One is to actually make sure that the home environment is helpful and that parents are providing the right type of support to their kids.
sentences.zh: 一方面是确保家庭环境确实是有益的，并且父母正在为他们的孩子提供正确类型的支持。

sentences.en: So it's not very helpful if a parent nags a kid or makes them feel bad about the poor choices that they're making, but rather in a supportive
sentences.zh: 因此，如果父母唠叨孩子或者让他们为自己做出的糟糕选择感到难过，这并没有什么帮助，相反，应该以一种支持性的

sentences.en: way enables them to make healthier choices.
sentences.zh: 方式让他们能够做出更健康的选择。

sentences.en: And sometimes this can be as simple as making sure that food is actually available in the house or that the foods when you first open the refrigerator or the
sentences.zh: 有时这可以很简单，比如确保家里确实有食物，或者当你第一次打开冰箱或食品

sentences.en: pantry are the good options or make sure that they've portioned foods correctly so that if a kid is
sentences.zh: 储藏室时，看到的都是好的选择，或者确保他们正确分配了食物分量，这样如果孩子

sentences.en: grabbing a snack, that they're not grabbing the huge bag of chips, that maybe they have an individual serving size bag of nuts.
sentences.zh: 在拿零食，他们不会去拿一大包薯片，而是可能有一小袋独立包装的坚果。

sentences.en: Those types of things parents can do, they can try and structure the environment in a way that's helpful without nagging, and they can be good role models themselves.
sentences.zh: 父母可以做这些类型的事情，他们可以尝试以一种有益的方式构建环境而不去唠叨，他们自己也可以成为好榜样。

sentences.en: But then when we're thinking about the influence of peers, often what we have to do is work individually with the teens themselves.
sentences.zh: 但是，当我们考虑同龄人的影响时，我们通常必须做的是与青少年本身进行单独的工作。

sentences.en: And a lot of the work that we do as psychologists is really helping kids stay motivated to take care of themselves and engage in behaviors that are good
sentences.zh: 我们作为心理学家所做的很多工作，实际上是帮助孩子保持动力去照顾自己，并参与那些对他们有益的

sentences.en: for them and help them find reasons for keeping themselves healthy.
sentences.zh: 行为，帮助他们找到保持自身健康的理由。

sentences.en: Because I, you know, a lot of what you're talking about, a nutritionist can tell you that those things, but what you're just touched
sentences.zh: 因为我，你知道，你所谈论的很多内容，营养学家也可以告诉你，但你刚才

sentences.en: on right now is how, why psychologists are so important and mental health experts are so important in this process.
sentences.zh: 谈到的是为什么心理学家和心理健康专家在这个过程中如此重要。

sentences.en: Because it's not just about saying, eat this, eat that, don't eat this, don't eat that.
sentences.zh: 因为这不仅仅是说，吃这个，吃那个，别吃这个，别吃那个。

sentences.en: It's about changing the mindset.
sentences.zh: 这是关于改变心态。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I think it's all about making healthful choices, and psychologists are really experts on why people make the choices that they do,
sentences.zh: 我认为这一切都是关于做出健康的抉择，而心理学家确实是关于人们为什么会做出这些抉择的专家，

sentences.en: and helping restructure the way they think about things, or where the behaviors are driven by
sentences.zh: 并帮助重构他们对事物的看法，或者在行为受

sentences.en: environmental factors, restructuring the environment to help make healthy choices be the easier choices, or the more readily taken choices.
sentences.zh: 环境因素驱动的情况下，重构环境以帮助让健康的抉择成为更容易的抉择，或是更顺理成章的抉择。

sentences.en: What about like the emotional aspect of it?
sentences.zh: 那情感方面呢？

sentences.en: I mean, I imagine some kids using food as an emotional support system.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我能想象一些孩子把食物当作情感支持系统。

sentences.en: Do you see that a lot?
sentences.zh: 你经常看到这种情况吗？

sentences.en: I think it's almost universal that people use food as coping.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们把食物作为应对机制几乎是普遍存在的。

sentences.en: And when you think back to the little kids, parents often structure things that way.
sentences.zh: 当你回想小孩子时，父母经常会这样构建事情。

sentences.en: They reward kids with dessert, or going out to eat, or an unhealthful treat.
sentences.zh: 他们用甜点、外出吃饭或不健康的零食来奖励孩子。

sentences.en: And from an early age, we're set up to expect that food, especially unhealthful but tasty foods, are a reward.
sentences.zh: 从小开始，我们就习惯于预期食物——尤其是那些不健康但美味的食物——是一种奖励。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of good research showing that those types of foods activate those same regions of the brain that are reward-driven in the same way that drugs and alcohol might.
sentences.zh: 有许多很好的研究表明，这些类型的食物会激活大脑中与药物和酒精以同样方式受奖励驱动的相同区域。

sentences.en: And so we set up the environment for kids to reinforce that, and our brains are already driven in that way.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们为孩子建立环境来强化这一点，我们的大脑也已经以这种方式受到驱动。

sentences.en: So by the time you get to adolescence, you often see that reward-driven eating, and you also see eating to cope.
sentences.zh: 所以到了青春期，你经常会看到这种由奖励驱动的进食，你还会看到为了应对压力而进食。

sentences.en: And we all know that adolescence can be a stressful time, that kids go to school and may get in arguments with their peers, or may have stress related to their schoolwork.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道青春期可能是一个充满压力的时期，孩子们去学校可能会与同龄人争吵，或者可能有与学业相关的压力。

sentences.en: And oftentimes what they do is they come home, and we often see the school day structured so that kids have a long break between when they have lunch and when they come home.
sentences.zh: 通常他们做的是回家，我们经常看到学校的一天安排得让孩子们在吃午饭和回家之间有很长的一段休息时间。

sentences.en: They're often starving by the time they get home.
sentences.zh: 他们到家时往往饿极了。

sentences.en: They may be tired and have less self-control, and they may also be experiencing a variety of negative emotions related to their school day.
sentences.zh: 他们可能很累，自我控制能力较差，而且他们可能还经历着与学校生活相关的各种负面情绪。

sentences.en: And all of those things create the perfect storm for overeating or loss of control eating when they get home, and it can become kind of a vicious cycle.
sentences.zh: 所有这些因素共同为他们回家后暴饮暴食或失去饮食控制创造了完美的风暴，这可能会演变成一种恶性循环。

sentences.en: Mental health experts like you and even parents, they're really struggling, I think, to straddle a line between body shaming
sentences.zh: 像你这样的心理健康专家，甚至父母，他们真的在努力在身体羞辱

sentences.en: and helping kids behave in a way that's best for their own bodies and their own health.
sentences.zh: 和帮助孩子以最适合自己身体和健康的方式行事之间走钢丝。

sentences.en: Eating disorders are especially common among teens, as we know.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所知，饮食失调在青少年中尤其常见。

sentences.en: How can parents navigate those tricky waters?
sentences.zh: 父母如何才能驾驭这些棘手的局面？

sentences.en: I think that's really important, and I think the key take-home for families is that encouraging your child to have high self-esteem and making them feel good about themselves
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的很重要，我认为给家庭的最终核心建议是，鼓励你的孩子拥有高自尊，让他们对自己感觉良好

sentences.en: is the best way to have them want to take care of themselves.
sentences.zh: 是让他们想要照顾好自己的最佳途径。

sentences.en: So if you don't talk about weight or appearance but instead focus on health and well-being, kids are much more likely to buy into
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你不谈论体重或外表，而是专注于健康和福祉，孩子们更有可能接受

sentences.en: that idea and not have the negative feedback that they get from weight.
sentences.zh: 这个想法，并且不会受到因体重带来的负面反馈。

sentences.en: So if you have a parent who approaches it by saying, honey, I think you are a little bit overweight or you need to start working on your weight.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果有这样一个家长，他们处理的方式是说：亲爱的，我觉得你稍微有点超重了，或者你需要开始控制你的体重了。

sentences.en: Let's change the way we eat.
sentences.zh: 让我们改变我们的饮食方式。

sentences.en: That's going to have a whole series of negative emotions that comes along with it, and it's going to end up becoming more of a problem than help.
sentences.zh: 这会带来一系列随之而来的负面情绪，最终它带来的问题会比提供的帮助还要多。

sentences.en: And we often see well-meaning parents go down that route.
sentences.zh: 我们经常看到好心的父母走这条路。

sentences.en: But if that same well-meaning parent instead said, I feel like as a family we're really not taking care of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但如果同一个好心的家长转而说：我觉得作为一家人，我们真的没有照顾好自己。

sentences.en: We're eating a lot more junk food than we need to, and I feel like it's really not helping us be healthier.
sentences.zh: 我们吃的垃圾食品比我们需要的要多得多，我觉得这真的无助于我们变得更健康。

sentences.en: I can tell that we're just running out of energy or having trouble focusing.
sentences.zh: 我能看出我们只是在耗尽精力或者难以集中注意力。

sentences.en: As a family, we're really going to take better care of ourselves because we're important and you're important to me, and here's how we're going to do it.
sentences.zh: 作为一个家庭，我们要真正更好地照顾自己，因为我们很重要，你对我也很重要，这就是我们要怎么做。

sentences.en: And I think that that sends a very different message, and I think the more you promote good self-esteem and desire to take care of yourself, the better off you'll be.
sentences.zh: 我认为这传递了一个非常不同的信息，而且我认为你越是培养良好的自尊和照顾自己的愿望，你的情况就会越好。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's great advice.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是个很好的建议。

sentences.en: You mentioned that the conversation has to be directed as a family effort.
sentences.zh: 你提到对话必须作为一种家庭努力来引导。

sentences.en: Why is that so important in the process of getting teens to be healthier?
sentences.zh: 为什么这在让青少年变得更健康的过程中如此重要？

sentences.en: Well, teenagers especially are really self-conscious.
sentences.zh: 嗯，尤其是青少年，他们真的非常自我意识过剩。

sentences.en: They tend to feel that everyone is focused on them, and they often feel singled out, and that can be a pretty negative experience.
sentences.zh: 他们往往觉得每个人都在关注他们，而且他们经常觉得自己被挑出来了，这可能是一种相当消极的体验。

sentences.en: And so if you have a kid in a family who's struggling with healthy eating or weight, the worst thing you can do is make
sentences.zh: 因此，如果家里有一个孩子在健康饮食或体重问题上挣扎，你能做的最糟糕的事情就是让

sentences.en: them feel singled out or different because of that difficulty.
sentences.zh: 他们因为这个困难而觉得自己被挑出来或者与众不同。

sentences.en: And so we often counsel families to try and make any change as a family rather than singling out one kid or making sure that it's not just one
sentences.zh: 因此，我们经常建议家庭尝试作为一个整体来进行任何改变，而不是挑出一个孩子，或者确保不仅仅是一个

sentences.en: kid who's not allowed to have dessert.
sentences.zh: 孩子不被允许吃甜点。

sentences.en: That as a family, you make a decision that you're going to eat healthier.
sentences.zh: 而是作为一个家庭，你们做出决定要吃得更健康。

sentences.en: And so it's really important that parents not nag or not single out and make sure that they focus on the whole family and family-wide changes in order to be supportive.
sentences.zh: 因此，父母不唠叨或不单独挑出某人，并确保他们关注整个家庭和全家范围内的改变以提供支持，这真的很重要。

sentences.en: I've also seen research suggesting there's a link between dietary habits and mental health.
sentences.zh: 我还看到研究表明饮食习惯与心理健康之间存在联系。

sentences.en: What do we know about how mental health and diet are linked?
sentences.zh: 关于心理健康和饮食是如何联系的，我们都知道些什么？

sentences.en: There's a lot of good research showing about diet and about exercise, and all of us can sort of relate.
sentences.zh: 有很多关于饮食和锻炼的优秀研究，我们所有人都能感同身受。

sentences.en: If you have a day that you're eating unhealthily, grabbing stuff on the go, not having fruits, vegetables, protein, you start dragging.
sentences.zh: 如果你有一天饮食不健康，随手抓着吃东西，没有吃水果、蔬菜、蛋白质，你就会开始感到无精打采。

sentences.en: Your energy levels are low.
sentences.zh: 你的能量水平很低。

sentences.en: We know that it can affect the way you think and how quickly you are to react to things.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这会影响你的思维方式以及你对事物的反应速度。

sentences.en: And it just changes a lot about your emotions.
sentences.zh: 它只是改变了你很多的的情绪。

sentences.en: It can also change the way you sleep.
sentences.zh: 它还可以改变你的睡眠方式。

sentences.en: And sleep, as we know, has a big impact on emotions.
sentences.zh: 而且正如我们所知，睡眠对情绪有很大的影响。

sentences.en: We also know that exercise really helps promote better well-being and can lift mood.
sentences.zh: 我们还知道，锻炼确实有助于促进更好的幸福感并能提升情绪。

sentences.en: And so if you've got a kid who's not eating very well, who's not exercising very much, it definitely can translate into mood.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你有一个孩子吃得不太好、锻炼得也不多，这绝对会转化为情绪问题。

sentences.en: And oftentimes some of the things we recommend for kids who are experiencing depression are to eat at regular times, healthy foods, to get out and exercise.
sentences.zh: 通常我们对经历抑郁症的孩子推荐的一些做法是按时吃健康的食物，出去锻炼。

sentences.en: And those things do seem to help mood.
sentences.zh: 这些事情确实对改善情绪有帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, their hormones are already at a level that, you know, they're having a hard time adjusting.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，他们的荷尔蒙已经达到了一个水平，你知道的，他们很难适应。

sentences.en: I can see that.
sentences.zh: 我能理解这一点。

sentences.en: Now, part of your work is also counseling teens who are considering bariatric surgery, which is when doctors reduce the size of the stomach with a gastric band or
sentences.zh: 现在，你工作的一部分还包括为考虑减肥手术的青少年提供咨询，减肥手术是指医生通过胃束带或

sentences.en: the removal of a portion of the stomach.
sentences.zh: 切除一部分胃来缩小胃的容量。

sentences.en: Can you explain briefly what, you know, this type of surgery is and why it's so important for anyone considering this procedure to consult with a psychologist like you?
sentences.zh: 你能简要解释一下这种手术是什么，以及为什么任何考虑这个手术的人咨询像你这样的心理学家都如此重要吗？

sentences.en: I think it's important to note that kids who go through bariatric surgery have a different disease than kids who are just struggling with their weight.
sentences.zh: 我认为值得注意的是，经历减肥手术的孩子与那些仅仅在与体重作斗争的孩子患有不同的疾病。

sentences.en: So overweight or even class one obesity, which is sort of the lower end of obesity, that's also a chronic illness, but it's
sentences.zh: 因此，超重甚至是重度肥胖的一级——也就是肥胖的较低端——这也是一种慢性病，但它

sentences.en: something that generally is managed with the help of a doctor through lifestyle management.
sentences.zh: 通常是通过医生的帮助和生活方式管理来控制的。

sentences.en: When you start seeing severe obesity, which is the fastest growing category of obesity among kids and teens, that's when
sentences.zh: 当你开始看到严重肥胖时——这是儿童和青少年中增长最快的肥胖类别——那才是你

sentences.en: you start to get to a body mass index of 35 or greater, and it comes along with a lot of other health
sentences.zh: 开始达到身体质量指数（BMI）35或更高的时候，它会伴随着许多其他的健康

sentences.en: probleMs. It has a big impact on quality of life and increases risk for type 2 diabetes, hypertension, a
sentences.zh: 问题。它对生活质量有很大的影响，并增加了患2型糖尿病、高血压和

sentences.en: number of other probleMs. The problem is, is that a lot of the treatments we have for overweight and obesity don't work for severe obesity.
sentences.zh: 许多其他问题的风险。问题在于，我们针对超重和肥胖的许多治疗方法对严重肥胖并不起作用。

sentences.en: So lifestyle management, just changing the way kids are eating and exercise are very likely to not be successful with severe obesity.
sentences.zh: 因此，生活方式管理，仅仅改变孩子的饮食方式和运动，对于严重肥胖来说很可能是不成功的。

sentences.en: So the one treatment that has emerged as the most effective treatment for severe obesity is bariatric surgery, but it certainly does change the way that you're able to eat.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为治疗严重肥胖最有效的疗法脱颖而出的是减肥手术，但它确实改变了你进食的能力。

sentences.en: It changes your anatomy and it changes a lot about your life, sometimes for the better, but sometimes not in ways that kids expect.
sentences.zh: 它改变了你的解剖结构，并改变了你生活的很多方面，有时是为了变得更好，但有时并不是孩子们所期望的方式。

sentences.en: And so we have kids meet with the psychologist prior to surgery to make sure that they understand the process, to make sure that
sentences.zh: 因此，我们让孩子们在手术前与心理学家见面，以确保他们理解整个过程，确保

sentences.en: they are able to provide consent, and to identify any areas where we might be able to provide recommendations to increase their likelihood of success following surgery.
sentences.zh: 他们能够提供知情同意，并找出我们可能能够提供建议以增加他们在手术后成功可能性的任何领域。

sentences.en: Okay, well Dr. Mackey, thank you so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 好的，麦基博士，非常感谢您加入我们。

sentences.en: It's been a real pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一段非常愉快的时光。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听我们的播客。请务必查看我们《心理学谈话》的其他剧集，如果您还没有订阅，请订阅。

sentences.zh: 我们是APA播客网络的骄傲成员，其中包含其他精彩的播客。

sentences.zh: 如果您对心理学实践感兴趣，可以收听《进展记录》。

sentences.zh: 话题包括医疗保健政策和社交媒体如何影响执业心理学家。

sentences.zh: 您可以在iTunes、Stitcher或任何您获取播客的地方找到这些播客。

sentences.zh: 您还可以访问我们的网站speakingofpsychology.org，收听更多剧集并收集有关我们讨论话题的更多资源。

sentences.en: Thanks for joining us.
sentences.zh: 感谢您的加入。

sentences.zh: 我是奥德丽
